# -keep-temp-files keeps every recipe file written for the F attribute, and
# says where each one is.
mkdir tmp
env TMPDIR=$WORK/tmp

mk -keep-temp-files -p 1 ok
stderr '^mk: recipe for ''ok'' kept in .*/tmp/mk-ok-'
exec ls tmp
stdout '^mk-ok-'

# kept for failed recipes too
! mk -keep-temp-files -p 1 fails
stderr 'recipe for ''fails'' kept in .*/tmp/mk-fails-'
exec ls tmp
stdout '^mk-fails-'

-- mkfile --
ok:VF:
	echo fine

fails:VF:
	false
